abstract.p: Non-interactive secure multiparty computation (NIMPC) is a variant of secure computation which allows each of n players to send only a single message depending on his input and correlated randomness. Abelian programs, which can realize any symmetric function, are defined as functions on the sum of the players' inputs over an abelian group and provide useful functionalities for real-world applications.
